patch.value: Report stale or contradictory knowledge in task recall
Reuse existing verification and supersession signals to expose bounded, checkable freshness and contradiction evidence during task recall.
Agents can recover source evidence for a disclosed conflict without reading every candidate.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Design: expose evidence through an opt-in SDK resume intent. Use a certified same-tracker snapshot, persist no recall exposure, keep complete rows within the existing ceiling, and report omitted rows and conflict evidence. Reuse native verification and supersession; disclose a single-field source only when it can adjudicate the competing guidance.

value.text: Scratch copy of the public tracker, with public facts and a synthetic recorded contradiction: resume plus both status, updated_at and dependencies reads took 262 TOON tokens (100 + 69 + 93). Counts use the SDK UTF-8 byte estimator.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The pinned SDK stores a forward supersedes relationship. Resume-evidence derives the incoming superseded side and identifies the item that owns the edge. Explicit opposing guidance can use a persisted stale reason. Reciprocal edges and opposing guidance without a decisive source produce a conflict_sources receipt. Local targeted recall tests passed; the legacy missing-field branch has a dedicated fixture under verification.
